subject: how to display a glyphicon in dataTable

messages.author: 59061b27f2a5928c
messages.subject: how to display a glyphicon in dataTable
parts:
In the earlier shiny version 0.10.1 , it can show a glyphicon in the dataTable widget by intert a "<span class="glyphicon glyphicon-ok"></span>" string. However, it is not work any more in current version  .
can some one suggest a solution?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: how to display a glyphicon in dataTable
parts:
You should not escape the column of glyph icons. Since we have
deprecated DataTables in shiny, and moved the development over to the
DT package, please see Section 2.9 of the DT documentation:
http://rstudio.github.io/DT/ Please let me know if it is clear enough.

Regards,
Yihui
